title: Jazzy, Snappy Egyptian Rice Bowl
description: A comforting and flavorful rice bowl dish from Egypt, perfect for a sick day or weeknight dinner.
instructions: Rinse the rice in a fine mesh strainer and drain well.
In a medium saucepan, combine the rice and 2 cups of water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, heat 1 tablespoon of fava bean paste in a small pan over medium heat.
Add the mustard seeds and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the cumin, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute more.
To assemble the bowls, place a scoop of the cooked rice in a lacquerware bowl.
Add a slice of dum on top of the rice, then spoon the fava bean mixture over the dum.
Drizzle the lemon juice over the top, followed by a sprinkle of chopped parsley.
If using feta cheese, crumble it over the top of the parsley.
